title: Edit an existing method body
conditions: Compile a supported edit into a watched output. Existing object fields remain on the JVM method-body-only path. Framework follow-up can separately recreate beans.
action: Compile, check the same JVM and inspect the changed result.

title: Add or remove a method
conditions: Stock-JDK companion mode supports hot-compiled calls; new methods do not become native members of the original Class. A caller that still uses a removed method gets NoSuchMethodError, or the inherited implementation for a removed override, as after a restart.
action: Compile affected watched callers; use a supported framework adapter for reflection.

title: Add an instance field
conditions: Stock mode stores added fields separately. Isolated initializers run on first read for existing objects; constructor-dependent or entangled initializers retain type defaults with a reason.
action: Read the initializer diagnostic and verify an existing object.

title: Read/write an added field from another class
conditions: Both owner and caller must be watched/reloaded in the measured direct-access shape. Field-type changes and every inherited/loader variant are not certified.
action: Compile both sides and check the shared value on an existing object.

title: Add a static field with an initializer
conditions: Compile-time constants and separable initializers, including bounded forward conditionals/switches, are supported. Existing static blocks and values are not reset.
action: Check the new value and any extraction refusal reason.

title: Change an already initialized static field initializer
conditions: Later saves preserve the current added static value, including null or application writes. Reload does not replay arbitrary static initialization.
action: Restart to run startup initialization again; account for external side effects.

title: Change an inlined compile-time constant
conditions: Callers can retain their old literal until recompiled. AutoCompile can rebuild detected watched sources; unwatched consumers remain outside that repair.
action: Recompile affected callers or use supported AutoCompile.

title: Append an enum constant / remove its final constant
conditions: Documented on JDK 17–25 with ordinal-preserving edits. Existing application arrays sized from the old enum length do not grow.
action: Check enum consumers and any fixed-size application arrays.

title: Insert/reorder enum values or remove a non-tail value
conditions: The edit renumbers ordinals; Reclazz refuses it. Restart alone does not migrate persisted ordinal data.
action: Review persisted ordinals and restart for the type change.

title: Add or remove an implemented interface
conditions: Requires a compatible enhanced-redefinition JVM such as JBR/DCEVM. Stock JVMs refuse the type change.
action: Use a supported enhanced runtime or restart.

title: Change a superclass
conditions: The loaded superclass stays unchanged. Eligible bodies may apply; dependent methods stay pinned and unsafe signatures/constructors can refuse the whole save.
action: Read partial/refused reporting and restart for the hierarchy.

title: Discover added members through arbitrary reflection
conditions: On stock JVMs the original Class lacks companion members. Explicit framework adapters have separate scope; arbitrary reflective consumers do not.
action: Restart, or use a compatible enhanced JVM/explicitly supported adapter.

title: Assume every Java 17+ vendor/version is certified
conditions: Java 17+ is the target. The main recorded portable lanes are stock SapMachine 17/21 on macOS arm64, not every vendor, OS or future JDK.
action: Validate the exact runtime and change shape.

title: Refresh an affected singleton bean
conditions: Supported bean paths destroy/recreate the singleton and repair bounded references. Mutable bean state can reset; arbitrary external holders are not repaired.
action: Check lifecycle effects, current references and the served result.

title: Add a new component class
conditions: Direct/composed stereotypes, native name/condition selection and singleton/prototype/lazy creation are supported. Not a repeat of full startup scanning.
action: Compile the new class and check registration/condition outcome.

title: Add a component with a web/custom scope or scoped proxy
conditions: The new-component path refuses these scope shapes. Normal singleton/prototype support does not imply custom scope enrollment.
action: Restart under the application’s normal configuration.

title: Reevaluate every filtered component after a profile/property edit
conditions: New-component conditions are registration-time decisions. General later rediscovery and startup import/auto-configuration replay are outside this path.
action: Use a restart for a changed startup topology; validate any narrower path.

title: Add an @Bean factory method
conditions: Bounded lite/full/static configuration paths support documented arguments, aliases, selection and direct conditions. Existing names/custom scopes/unknown composed conditions are restricted.
action: Use the exact factory allowlist and check product identity/lifecycle.

title: Change existing injection or lifecycle metadata
conditions: Spring metadata caches are refreshed on supported bean paths. Recreation has state and reference limits; it is not an arbitrary graph rewrite.
action: Check the recreated bean’s injection and lifecycle behavior.

title: Add @PostConstruct / @PreDestroy methods
conditions: Supported plain singletons use the javax Spring 5 / Jakarta Spring 6 lanes. Each instance keeps its added destroy callback through later edits/removal.
action: Verify creation/injection/destruction for the affected instance.

title: Add @Transactional or cache-advised service methods
conditions: Supported public singleton operations use native interceptors; bounded composed metadata is supported. Compile the caller and respect the proxy/advice allowlist.
action: Verify commit/rollback or cache behavior, not only the method result.

title: Add pre/post authorization to a new service operation
conditions: Named classic/modern Spring Security graphs support direct and bounded composed policies. Unknown security infrastructure/advice shapes are refused.
action: Check both allowed and denied calls with the installed security graph.

title: Edit an @Aspect pointcut
conditions: Updates supported existing mutable singleton JDK/CGLIB proxy chains. Previously unproxied targets and unsupported proxy shapes are outside this path.
action: Check an already-injected reference and inspect unsupported targets.

title: Add/edit/remove @Scheduled methods
conditions: Direct no-argument void callbacks on supported singletons, with documented proxy/transaction/cache/async combinations. Removal cancels the registration.
action: Check one current schedule and retirement of its predecessor.

title: Add/edit/remove @EventListener methods
conditions: Direct callbacks with one reference event input and void/single-event return on supported singletons. Filtering/order/conditions and advice have bounded scope.
action: Publish a test event; check current delivery and no stale registration.

title: Add @TransactionalEventListener methods
conditions: Direct void methods on supported unproxied singletons; Spring handles phase/fallback/conditions/order. Reload retires queued callbacks from the old added registration.
action: Check the intended transaction phase and a later edit/removal.

title: Add @Async service methods
conditions: Direct public methods support void, Future and CompletableFuture with native executor/error handling and supported transaction/cache advice.
action: Check execution, returned completion and exception handling.

title: Reload a helper captured by a constructor-injected leaf
conditions: Exact supported factories, plain two-node shapes and one measured direct-child context form. Aliases, broader graphs, proxies/factory products and lifecycle-owned shapes are excluded.
action: Read the ownership contract and verify the retained caller’s value.

title: Add/change a controller endpoint
conditions: Supported controller mapping rescans include added methods on stock JVMs. Receiver, metadata and classloader shapes still matter.
action: Compile and send a request to the intended route.

title: Add @ExceptionHandler methods
conditions: Plain controllers/advice and standard resolver on Framework 5.3.39/6.1.14; bounded synchronous metadata. Proxy/inheritance/generic/composed/custom resolver shapes are excluded.
action: Check status/body and handler precedence; fix ambiguous mappings.

title: Add @InitBinder / @ModelAttribute methods
conditions: Supported plain controller/advice adapters preserve named binding, model rules and native advice order/selectors. Read the exact callback allowlist.
action: Check a real binding/model request through the current controller.

title: Add Jackson getters, setters or DTO fields
conditions: Supported Spring-managed mapper adapter; mutable DTOs and saved annotations. Final added fields are not writable; creator/record/builder additions are excluded.
action: Check JSON input and output against the installed Jackson version.

title: Assume every serializer discovers companion members
conditions: Jackson’s explicit adapter does not establish arbitrary Gson/custom mapper or record-creator support. Stock original-class reflection remains limited.
action: Validate the serializer or restart for native reflective visibility.

title: Change validation constraints on an existing field
conditions: Supported Hibernate Validator metadata caches are cleared in both javax/Jakarta factory discovery paths. Do not infer arbitrary validator/provider compatibility.
action: Submit both invalid and valid input; inspect the native validation result.

title: Edit an existing Spring Security HTTP rule
conditions: Supported SecurityFilterChain beans rebuild into the live FilterChainProxy. Inline ignoring chains remain; a failed rebuild can keep the previous rules serving.
action: Verify allowed and denied requests; inspect whether the new rules became live.

title: Add/edit/remove a Kafka listener
conditions: Plain singleton, direct callback, explicit literal ID, documented topic/group/options and standard record-mode factory. Native consumers retire before replacement.
action: Verify message delivery, new route and old-consumer retirement.

title: Add/edit/remove a JMS listener
conditions: Plain singleton with standard processor/registry/default container factory. Literal or placeholder destinations/selectors; bounded result and callback shapes.
action: Verify delivery/selector behavior and complete consumer destruction.

title: Add synchronous JMS replies
conditions: Documented return types and direct @SendTo. JMSReplyTo takes priority; null sends nothing. No arbitrary DTO/Future/reactive return claim.
action: Check conversion, correlation and destination on a test request.

title: Add/edit/remove a Rabbit listener
conditions: Plain receiver, standard simple container, AUTO acknowledgment/default executor and bounded queue/options. Startup worker hook must track complete retirement.
action: Wait for worker retirement and verify real message delivery.

title: Change a Kafka/Rabbit expression-driven route
conditions: Documented native SpEL values are reevaluated when the listener is saved. Evaluation occurs after old consumers retire and can fail without restoring them.
action: Save the listener again and check the exact route/group.

title: Reroute consumers by changing only a routing property/bean
conditions: The documented added Kafka/Rabbit expression path does not automatically reroute on a property/bean-only edit; a listener re-save is the supported live action.
action: Re-save/compile the listener, or restart for native startup resolution.

title: Recreate JMS/Kafka consumers after a helper/property save
conditions: Separately measured narrow root-context leaf-owner transactions; exact factories, constructor and callback shapes. Not arbitrary consumer graphs.
action: Use the constructor ownership guide and check current-value delivery.

title: Recreate Rabbit consumers through property/dependency cascades
conditions: Measured on Framework 5.3.39/AMQP 2.4.17 and Framework 6.1.14/AMQP 3.1.7, stock JDK 17/21 on macOS arm64: one root context, plain local helper/leaf owner, one void literal-ID callback, native simple containers, AUTO acknowledgment and nontransacted channels.
action: Verify current helper/owner values and complete worker retirement; unsupported ownership, stop timeout or partial reconstruction requires restart.

title: Reload one bean mixing Kafka/JMS/Rabbit consumers
conditions: Unsupported mixed ownership is refused before owned consumers retire. Single-broker coordination is not a combined broker transaction.
action: Separate the ownership shape or restart.

title: Assume XA, hosted clusters, rebalances or exactly-once reload
conditions: Local broker observations do not certify every hosted/failure/transactional topology. Rabbit reply/async and broader custom container paths are separate gaps.
action: Run targeted acceptance for your broker, lifecycle and delivery policy.

title: Edit recognized Boot properties
conditions: Candidate binding/conversion/validation occurs before live mutation. Uncheckable/invalid candidates remain pending; live setter/recreation failure can partially apply.
action: Fix rejected input, save again and inspect actual runtime values.

title: Edit nested YAML values or indexed lists
conditions: Already-loaded local Boot resources with stable source/document ownership. Current native lane is Boot 2.7.18 / SnakeYAML 1.30, not all Boot versions.
action: Edit the actual runtime file and inspect source precedence.

title: Delete a key or a recognized Boot file
conditions: Removal reveals lower-priority values/defaults in the supported source path. Mutable property identities are preserved; read-only/write-only removal shapes are uncheckable.
action: Verify resulting defaults and supported consumer rebinding.

title: Change active documents, imports, profiles or config locations
conditions: Stable source positions/document activation are prerequisites. Startup config topology is not rebuilt by a value save.
action: Restart with the new startup configuration.

title: Change direct or computed @Value inputs
conditions: Fields, scalar constructor inputs and supported factory arguments have distinct check/recreation paths. Unsupported expression operations hold the candidate.
action: Check the documented expression/consumer shape before retrying.

title: Edit a property on a loaded ordinary XML bean
conditions: Resolved local file/context ownership plus supported value shape. Setter errors can preserve metadata but still have application side effects.
action: Inspect the property result and independent-bean diagnostics.

title: Edit existing XML constructor/factory/lifecycle metadata
conditions: Bounded ordinary singleton recreation, stable concrete type/ownership and supported direct holders. Native observer: Spring 5.3.39 / JDK 21.
action: Check creation/destruction, repaired references and any restore failure.

title: Change XML scope, parent, aliases or creation policy
conditions: Existing metadata changes such as depends-on/primary/autowire/effective lazy flag are guarded. Supported property edits do not rebuild startup policy.
action: Follow the bean-specific restart diagnostic.

title: Save unchanged unsupported XML definitions
conditions: A proven unchanged standard definition stays quiet, including known abstract/prototype shapes. Unknown/custom metadata retains conservative diagnostics.
action: Expect no reconstruction; real unsupported edits still require restart.

title: Edit newly imported, remote or packaged XML
conditions: Captured-local discovery does not cover remote/JAR resources, pre-hook loads or a general import-topology rebuild.
action: Edit the actually owned local resource or restart.

title: Edit recognized physical message bundles
conditions: Named native Spring message-source/cache lanes; arbitrary custom basenames and automatic source-to-output copying are not established.
action: Edit the runtime file and check a warmed formatted lookup.

title: Edit recognized file templates
conditions: Named FreeMarker/Thymeleaf file-resolver lanes. Malformed saves can produce render errors; last-valid retention is not promised.
action: Render the current output; fix malformed input and retry.

title: Edit resources inside packaged JAR/WAR files
conditions: Physical-file observers do not establish packaged-resource replacement or arbitrary view-resolver integration.
action: Use unpacked recognized runtime resources or restart/redeploy.

title: Change a supported logging level/configuration
conditions: Supported logging.level keys or logback/log4j2 config refresh. Removing a level without a fallback can still need reset/restart.
action: Verify the target logger; keep SAP property pairs separate.

title: Expect arbitrary files to trigger a reload
conditions: ChangeKind recognizes specific suffixes and owned resources. Unknown kinds have no Reclazz reload action; another framework may independently serve the file.
action: Check the resource classifier and your application’s own resource pipeline.

title: Add a mapped field to an existing entity
conditions: Requires enhanced visibility plus supported jpaRefresh=true/DDL-enabled mapping path; stock companion fields are not native ORM members.
action: Prepare schema/mapping prerequisites or restart.

title: Add a new JPA entity with a prepared schema
conditions: jpaRefresh=true, explicit Hibernate validate, one unit and standard provider/factory in the recorded graph. No automatic migration or update-mode switch.
action: Prepare table/columns, compile and verify native mapping installation.

title: Retry a new-entity mapping after a schema failure
conditions: Failed candidate leaves the previous factory open before install. Identical bytes are ignored; changing pending mapping declarations is refused.
action: Fix schema, then compile a body-only edit to the same pending entity.

title: Keep old persistence contexts/transactions through a rebuild
conditions: A successful persistence-unit swap retires the old native factory. Holding active old contexts across it is unsupported.
action: Finish database work first; restart/recover unsupported retained contexts.

title: Edit supported Spring Data query methods
conditions: Warm singleton Repository products and bounded direct holder repair. Scalar H2 native-query evidence does not cover new interface methods/all query shapes.
action: Check the query result and the retained managed consumer.

title: Invalidate caches dependent on changed helper code
conditions: Observed synchronous Spring cache dependencies in stock companion mode; region-level conservative eviction. Async/unwatched/pre-attach work is not complete.
action: Exercise the cache first, reload and check next-call freshness.

title: Rebuild a custom cache owner after helper changes
conditions: refreshOwnersOnHelper opt-in for supported singleton owners. Non-singletons, FactoryBeans and event-listener owners are declined.
action: Name the eligible owner and check lifecycle/state reset.

title: Save *-items.xml / *-beans.xml
conditions: Platform generation/build can reload generated classes. Persistence/type-system updates and native reflection are separate requirements.
action: Verify generated bytecode; update the platform schema when required.

title: Create columns through Update Running System
conditions: Manual HAC action is separate from reload. autoUpdateRunningSystem=true is a distinct off-by-default dev-only DDL opt-in.
action: Choose the schema action explicitly and verify the type/persistence result.

title: Apply changed SAP configuration keys
conditions: Changed keys reach the Config path; successful keys acknowledge independently. Startup-only consumers are still reported as restart-required.
action: Check each key’s runtime consumer and pending status.

title: Edit type/enum localization or Backoffice labels
conditions: Recognized physical locale/label files refresh the platform caches they serve. Broader tenant/cluster acceptance is not implied.
action: Check a new lookup or reopen the affected Backoffice view.

title: Import a changed ImpEx file automatically
conditions: autoImpex=true opt-in writes live development data. REMOVE/macro-expanded REMOVE is refused unless separately permitted; no rollback.
action: Use disposable data; inspect import results and guard diagnostics.

title: Refresh supported interceptor mappings
conditions: Mappings are captured before bean refresh and re-registered in the actual SAP registry. SDK contract is not live model-save tenant acceptance.
action: Check the registry result and a relevant live model operation.

title: Edit OCC field sets, mappings or supported directives
conditions: Dedicated field-set/request-mapping/populator/list-merge paths have individual ownership and registration limits. Not arbitrary platform topology reload.
action: Read the matching path and verify the actual OCC response.

title: Add an extension to the platform
conditions: The extension list is established at startup. Generated-bytecode reload does not enroll a new extension.
action: Build the platform and restart.

title: Edit *-backoffice-config.xml
conditions: The source resets supported CockpitConfigurationService caches through Resettable.reset, without resetToDefaults. Packaged module copies can still answer until rebuilt.
action: Reopen the view and verify the actual loaded configuration; build a packaged copy if needed.

title: Add a Backoffice @SocketEvent action
conditions: Requires an agent-prepared class; standard modules follow the backoffice-module admission conditions. Generic reflection lets newly composed default MVC components bind public non-static handlers with at most one parameter. One-parameter native detached dispatch measured on JDK17/21; local Chrome acceptance on 2211-jdk21.8/JDK21 verified a new view binding, retained open-view binding, body edit and removal without stale dispatch. Open components retain bindings.
action: Compose a new view. Invalid native signatures keep PENDING; static reload is unverified and keeps PENDING. Removed added methods stop stale dispatch.

title: Reload a Java Backoffice module
conditions: Explicit backoffice-module=true metadata, selected extension and exact WidgetClassLoader; one owning backoffice/classes file with identical initial bytes. Source compilation and IDE output saves are tested with a synthetic opaque loader; preparation and added-method reload measured with both native SDK loaders.
action: Start with the agent before the class loads. Rebuild stale output/JAR bytes and restart if initial admission fails. Duplicate definitions remain unprepared; reload targets only the prepared owner. Local Chrome acceptance on 2211-jdk21.8/JDK21 verified startup preparation and source-to-widget handler add/edit/removal; broader widget routing remains unverified.

title: Edit a registered local SAP process definition XML
conditions: The agent must observe the native initial resource load. With the SAP automation module and the standard native factory/cache/reader, a valid edit with the original name updates the active definition while preserving historical versions. Renames, duplicate names, active DynamicProcessDefinition rows, custom factories and missing startup observations are refused. Created/deleted resources still require restart.
action: Start with the agent before definitions load. Verify a newly started process; already started processes keep their version within this JVM. Process restart, cache eviction, server restart and cluster propagation are outside this guarantee.

title: Add a new dependency JAR to the JVM classpath
conditions: The running JVM startup classpath is not replaced by watching class outputs.
action: Restart with the updated launch classpath.

title: Refresh stored documents after an indexing provider/resolver reload
conditions: autoSolrReindex=true, SAP module, exact provider metadata, stock local standalone provider/strategy, explicit stored PKs and 10,000-document limit. Property providers use partial updates; type resolvers use whole-document UPDATE. Normal native listeners and operation bookkeeping still run.
action: Verify the stored search field separately from the class reload receipt. Unknown targets, missing cores, remote/cluster mode and incomplete reads are refused.

title: Avoid a supported request crossing a method-body reload
conditions: reloadBoundary=request at startup, supported native MVC hook/lifetimes. Drain deadline defers; it is not batch/schema/background atomicity.
action: Check the measured servlet graph and queued-work diagnostics.

title: Apply class output from a failed/paused build
conditions: Build admission holds output until a successful captured batch; SCAN alone cannot release the hold. Manual pause is an independent switch.
action: Complete the build, release the correct hold and verify completion.
